executable: qpc/family.py: claim_status(), q_status(), overall_label(); tested exhaustively in qpc/tests/test_truth_table.py
agreement: PROTOCOL.md section 11 states exactly these rules; the protocol text and the executable must agree (unlike dpc, where NO_FEASIBLE_CONTROL was ambiguous). Any disagreement found later is a defect, not an interpretation.

nominee: TECHNICAL_FAILURE (candidate set not computable; ALSO an otherwise eligible nominee blocked only because one of its guard comparators -- C_rate(J) or C_global for J*, T* for P* -- is not a NOMINEE: guards are never dropped)
comparator: TECHNICAL_FAILURE (missing or uncomputable: absent unit, failed audit, failed control coverage, nonfinite input)
clauses: ANY_INVALID (nonfinite primary statistic or unestimable metric)

claim_status_rules_in_precedence_order: comparator == TECHNICAL_FAILURE or nominee == TECHNICAL_FAILURE -> INVALID_COMPARATOR (if the comparator) / INVALID_NOMINEE (if only the nominee); technical failure dominates
nominee == NO_ELIGIBLE -> NOT_ESTABLISHED_NO_ELIGIBLE_NOMINEE (a completed negative for this claim; fallback rows DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY)
comparator == NO_ELIGIBLE -> NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_ELIGIBLE_COMPARATOR (NOT a valid head-to-head negative; counts as missing comparator coverage)
otherwise -> NOT_ESTABLISHED (a completed valid head-to-head negative)
q_star_status_rules: no eligible Stage A configuration -> NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_Q (only possible if the gate failed)
any of the 4 Q* clauses INVALID -> INVALID
all 4 clauses PASS -> PASS (confidence preservation established on the locked reused assessment)
overall_label_rules_in_precedence_order: Stage A technically incomplete or invalid -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID
capacity gate not met (no globally eligible Stage A code) -> CAPACITY_GATE_NOT_MET (privacy stage and assessment not run)
any required technical validity failed (failed positive control without amendment, verification FAIL on a primary quantity, missing locked unit) -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID

A == PASS and B == PASS -> JOINT_DEVELOPMENT_CRITERION_MET (joined with ' + PRIVACY_COMPRESSION_DEVELOPMENT_CRITERION_MET (<family>)' if C == PASS); any other claim with missing coverage is listed in missing_items, never hidden
C == PASS -> PRIVACY_COMPRESSION_DEVELOPMENT_CRITERION_MET (<winning family>); claims A/B with missing coverage are listed in missing_items
no favourable label and any claim in coverage_missing_or_invalid, or Q* INVALID / unresolved -> INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID (the missing items are listed)
Q* == PASS -> CONFIDENCE_FEASIBILITY_ESTABLISHED (comparisons completed validly, no method advantage)
otherwise -> EXPERIMENTAL_NO_ADVANTAGE (comparisons completed validly, no method advantage, Q* not established)
notes: A favourable claim never passes through a fallback: a fallback nominee is NO_ELIGIBLE and its rows are DESCRIPTIVE_ONLY.
Passing only against continuous U does not establish a joint contribution: JOINT_DEVELOPMENT_CRITERION_MET requires both A (vs C_rate) and B (vs C_global).

C_rate always contains the Stage A DIRECT-TASK code at J*'s rate (selected rates are eligible DIRECT-TASK rates), and C_global/T* always contain U continuous (eligible by construction); NO_ELIGIBLE comparators are therefore expected only if that construction fails, which is itself reported.
The per-claim table is always published, even when a favourable label exists.

Claim A's C_rate is resolved at the J* nominee cell, else at the J* descriptive-fallback cell; when J* has neither (J* itself a technical failure), C_rate is INVALID_COMPARATOR ('no J* cell') and the missing items name the J* failure as the root cause.

A validly PASSing claim keeps its favourable label even when another claim lacks coverage (prompt: INCOMPLETE_OR_INVALID is for REQUIRED validity or coverage); the per-claim table and missing_items always show the gap. Registered before any inner or assessment data (math review SEL-R1/SEL-C2, recorded in STAGE_B_LOCK).
